summary: A small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave apremilast a medium risk score of 63 for the liver and a low risk score of 32 for the heart [M]. Official warnings note that serious allergic reactions, including severe swelling (angioedema) and severe whole-body allergic responses (anaphylaxis), have occurred after the drug reached the market [3]. The medicine should not be taken by people with a known extreme sensitivity or allergy to apremilast or any of its ingredients [3].
